system.description: Armor Digimon routes on ten Vital Bracelet cards (step 13). Collected 2026-11-21 by tools/digimon/research/scripts/armor_routes.py from the humulos.com charts and detail pages (device 13 = VB DIM, 14 = VB BE; BE cards count PP where DIM cards count Trophies). For each card: `cardStages` is the chart column each Armor Digimon stands in; `edges` are the card's routes with an Armor Digimon at either end that stay on the card, in the format of the vb-conditions-*.json files; `digimentals` gives each Child (non-Armor) -> Armor step the Digimental that opens it in the app. Third-party quotes: review before a public release (see README).

kinds.fallback: taken when nothing else is met
kinds.adventure: stat requirements after an Adventure stage

system.digimentalRule: pair: Wikimon's Digimental Evolution Chart lists that Digimon with that Armor under this Digimental. representative: the chart has no such pair, so the Armor's first chart column (courage, friendship, love, knowledge, purity, reliability, hope, light, kindness, miracles, fate) is used.

digimentalChart.source: https://wikimon.net/Template:DigimentalEvoList1 (shown on https://wikimon.net/Digimental_Evolution_Chart), fetched 2026-11-21. Text licensed CC BY-SA 3.0.
